adjudication.rationale: The diff shows both client and server treat email uniqueness and existing-attendee checks as case-sensitive. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters with `guest === attendee.email` and compares `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without normalizing case, while the client-side Zod `Set(emails)` uniqueness check in `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` is also case-sensitive. Therefore `Alice@x.com` can be added even if `alice@x.com` is already an attendee, leading to duplicated attendees being created via `createMany` and then included in `updateCalendarAttendees` / `sendAddGuestsEmails`, plausibly causing duplicate invites/emails.
